scope: Controlled Pencil2 RTV4 host-Mesa replay of the same captured 84 records. The draw matrix is varied by a host adapter. This is not native Drawing, saved-note, Android, or public SVG/PDF rendering.
limitations: The scalar implementation is an approximation of host fragment interpolation and blend rounding, not a capture of fragment values.
Only the stated crop is retained. The source frame support was checked within this crop.
Scale 2 changes only the draw matrix on the same stream, not the Drawing sampler inverse-scale state. Other transforms, framebuffer sizes, color, readers and device behavior remain unverified.

source_alpha_rounding_hypothesis.law: round source alpha to the nearest 8-bit normalized value before each source-over blend; quantize the destination after every blend
source_alpha_rounding_hypothesis.status: host arithmetic hypothesis, not an observed internal GPU step

size2_controls.crop_method: Read RGBA from /tmp/pencil2-black.rgba and /tmp/pencil2-color.rgba, reverse their 192 rows from bottom-origin to top-origin, and extract alpha in the specified crop.

source_alpha_rounding_hypothesis.limitations: Alpha-only comparisons on five controlled host-Mesa frames do not prove source quantization, exact interpolation, RGB, PDF, saved-note or device behavior.

quantized_raster_export_control.scope: Fixed 192x192 output with white paper. Scalar-model alpha is encoded as black RGBA PNG, embedded in a hand-built SVG, and exported using public render_svg_pages_pdf at 72 DPI. This does not exercise the public Stroke renderer. Size2 color control tests its alpha as black; it does not test RGB.
quantized_raster_export_control.metrics: Each error tuple is differing pixels, sum of absolute channel error, maximum channel error against 255 minus the native transparent-frame alpha. Outside retained crop the native frame is assumed empty based on capture support checks.
quantized_raster_export_control.limitations: Resolution- and device-coordinate-specific, requires rerendering at each output transform and size; no scalable vector correction, public stroke pipeline, colored RGB, native white-paper paint, Android, saved note, or device parity established. File size is a single tiny synthetic stroke in a mostly empty frame, not a document-wide cost estimate.
